selected_on: leave-one-department-out mean macro-F1 (unseen-department transfer), not CV
reason: Re-selected 2026-08-09 after adding LTAE as a third candidate. Unchanged: lightgbm_nometa_nolat still wins the deciding criterion. It leads the LODO mean (0.4765 vs LTAE 0.4422 and lightgbm_nometa 0.4169), is best in 8 of 14 departments, and ties lightgbm_nometa on pooled LODO (-0.0015). centroid_lat transfers like a lookup table, not like signal. See docs/all_peru/RESULTS.md 6.2/6.3.

candidates.note: NEGATIVE RESULT. Structurally static-free (per-date tensors only), so the centroid_lat memorisation mechanism cannot apply to it at all -- yet it does NOT transfer best. It sits between the two LightGBM variants on LODO mean and is WORST on LODO pooled (-0.029 vs both). Its one win is consistency: the lowest across-department spread of the three (0.056 vs 0.082/0.098). It also loses CV to lightgbm_nometa (0.602 vs 0.628), reversing Piura, where tuned LTAE beat LightGBM on all five folds. Removing centroid_lat from LightGBM helps transfer (+0.060); removing every static via a different architecture does not help further.
